en: Color postcard showing a socialist‑era central square with a circular fountain set in a landscaped lawn. Behind it are a mid‑rise hotel with a rooftop sign reading "Hotel Moldova" and rows of apartment blocks. Many pedestrians are visible. The reverse side is a Romanian postcard template with a 40‑bani Poșta Română stamp and postmarks dated 10.6.69, along with printed caption "BACĂU – Vedere."
